title: A late writer recreates a termal-delegation-* test temp root's state/termal.sqlite after its guard removed it
outcome: The test whose state outlives its TestTempRoot is named with the late writer's thread and stack. That test waits for or joins the writer (or drops every state-owning handle) before its guard drops, so no full gate leaves a residual termal-delegation-* root, and the launcher's temp-cleanup guard passes on DL560 and Windows.
acceptance: Every AppState booted on a temp_delegation_state_paths root holds that root, so the root is removed only after its last AppState clone drops; a source-lock test fails if a test boots AppState::new_with_paths on such a root without attaching it; the full gate is green on the change.
